package datatable

import "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"

type ReadOption[M any] struct{}
type ExportOption[M any] struct{}

func ReadAccess[M any](http.AccessRule[M]) ReadOption[M]     { return ReadOption[M]{} }
func ExportAccess[M any](http.AccessRule[M]) ExportOption[M] { return ExportOption[M]{} }

type Table struct{}
type Config[M any] struct{}

func Routes[M any](http.Scope, Table, Config[M], ReadOption[M], ...ExportOption[M]) error { return nil }
